name: Start with a tool you can maintain

pages.text: Build a Part Builder and Tinker Station, then use the available early materials to assemble your first tools. Read Materials and You to learn how parts, traits and repairs work together.$(br2)Choose repair materials you can obtain reliably. A powerful tool is less useful when repairing it requires an expedition you are not ready to make.
Keep spare materials beside the station and bring suitable repair supplies on longer trips.
